name: switchboard
description: Side pane listing your local Claude sessions with their title, status and PR

ticketUrl.title: Ticket URL prefix
ticketUrl.description: Ticket IDs found in a session (like ABC-123) are appended to this to make a link, e.g. https://yourcompany.atlassian.net/browse/. Leave empty to show them without links.

bell.title: Chime when a session finishes
bell.description: Play a chime when another session goes from busy (yellow) to idle (green).
